about_short_description.short_description: Disrupt-X provides AI- and IoT-based real estate and facility management solutions through its automation platform.

product.name: ALEF 360° CAFM | CMMS
product.description: A facility management platform that streamlines maintenance, asset performance, workforce, and operational cost management.

product.name: ALEF 360° IoT Platform
product.description: An IoT platform providing real-time monitoring and control of environmental, asset, and utility sensors across properties.

product.name: ALEF 360° iBMS
product.description: A cloud-based integrated building management system for centralized monitoring and control of building systems and equipment.

product.name: ALEF 360° Asset Management
product.description: A platform for centralized tracking and lifecycle management of physical and digital assets across properties.

product.name: ALEF 360° Navigate
product.description: A real-time tracking solution for assets, personnel, and fleets using GPS, BLE, and IoT connectivity.

product.name: ALEF 360° Digital Twin
product.description: An interactive 3D visualization platform that integrates building systems and asset data for real-time operational insight.
